text:
Update: New footage shows the US Navy hailing the cargo ship MV Huda over the radio before disabling it in the Gulf of Oman.

CENTCOM says the civilian crew ignored repeated warnings and tried to break the naval blockade.
🚨 BREAKING: The US has approved a possible $1.08 billion sale of 11 UH60M Black Hawk helicopters to Mexico.

Moro Islamic Liberation Front fighters in the Philippines' Bangsamoro region were filmed testing a homemade sniper rifle: a bolt action .308 AR10 clone with Magpul style parts, a Bushnell 3 to 9x40 scope and an M14 magazine.
Update: Riyadh's Civil Defense says the danger has passed after several loud explosions were heard over the Saudi capital following its early warning alert.
🚨 BREAKING: Loud booms are being heard in Saudi Arabia's capital Riyadh after an early warning alert was issued.
Update: Satellite imagery shows the ship struck about five hours ago in the Gulf of Oman, near the Strait of Hormuz, is now drifting and sinking.
🚨 Another fire has been spotted in the Gulf of Oman, and a ship there appears to have been targeted.

🚨 Satellite imagery shows a fire breaking out at Saudi Arabia's Abqaiq oil field, minutes after a reported Yemeni strike.

The blaze follows the earlier air raid sirens across the Eastern Province.
Update: Saudi civil defence has given the all clear in the Eastern Province after the earlier air raid alerts.

Update: As Egypt's foreign minister visited Tripoli, pro Haftar figures in eastern Libya demanded a halt to Egypt's Oweinat to Kufra to Chad highway.

The irony: Haftar's son Belqasem signed the 2024 deal for Libya's section of the road.

Egypt's Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty visited Tripoli, Cairo's first top level diplomatic trip to the Libyan capital since October 2021.

Libyan PM Dbeibeh pledged to address Egypt's concerns over Libya's maritime deal with Turkey.
China has carried out a test of its anti ballistic missile interceptors.
🚨 The UAE National Guard says its Coast Guard rescued 22 people from a cargo ship that caught fire in the Gulf of Oman after it was hit by an Iranian anti ship cruise missile.
🚨 BREAKING: Air raid sirens are sounding across Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province, including Dammam, Abqaiq, Hofuf and Dhahran.

Update on Iran's Arman export: the system Iran sold abroad is the Arman tactical ballistic missile, known at home as Ababil, not the Arman air defense system.

The buyer is most likely Armenia, not Russia, which already fields its own ballistic missiles.

At least two people have been killed in Erbil, Iraq, as heavy flooding swept away cars and swamped homes, Iraqi media report.

Search and rescue teams are still working.

Update: Dana White says he is flying to Washington right now for a Monday meeting after President Trump offered him the White House press secretary job.

The UFC boss noted he already has plenty of jobs and will say more after the meeting.
Update: The US Air Force E11A BACN airborne communications jet that left Robins AFB has now landed at Ramstein Air Base in Germany, ahead of its deployment to Prince Sultan Air Base in Saudi Arabia.

🚨 Several US Air Force C17A heavy transport jets have reached the Middle East in recent hours after flying out of Fort Bragg, home of the 82nd Airborne, Army special operations and JSOC.

One flight stopped at Al Minhad Air Base in the UAE before moving on.
Update: The death toll from airstrikes near Yemen's capital Sanaa has risen to 33, according to the Houthi run health ministry.
